/** Find literal substrings; punctuation is never a regular expression. */
export function findIssues(issues, query) { return issues.filter(issue => String(issue.label).includes(query)); }

# Label Policy

Whitespace becomes hyphens, identifiers are lowercase, and empty labels use `unlabeled`. Related callers: issue-summary and issue-report.
files.docs/usage.md:
# Usage

Only open issues appear in `summarizeIssues`. `findIssues` searches literal substrings. [Label policy](labels.md).

unstaged.src/issue-search.mjs:
/** Find literal substrings; punctuation is never a regular expression. */
export function findIssues(issues, query) { return issues.filter(issue => new RegExp(query).test(String(issue.label))); }
